name: spec-loop-web-tdd
description: A gated Spec-Loop workflow that clarifies requirements, creates or validates SPEC, asks ChatGPT Web for the implementation plan and review, and executes TDD through subagents.

interface.shortDescription: SPEC-first Web GPT planning and review with subagent TDD.
interface.longDescription: Runs a SPEC-first development loop: clarify requirements, create or update the SPEC, send a self-contained handoff to ChatGPT Web for planning, execute isolated TDD tasks through subagents, and perform snapshot-bound Web GPT review.
defaultPrompt: Run the SPEC-first Web GPT TDD workflow for this task.
Create or update the SPEC, then ask ChatGPT Web for an implementation plan.
Review this change with the correct repository mode and Web GPT.
